meta.title: Devlog: July 19, 2026 - July 26, 2026
meta.description: due or die gained clearer onboarding, subscription controls, interface feedback, and a weekly accountability recap.

bullets.text: delivered a more complete onboarding path that clarifies setup and premium access from the first screen.
added plan selection, purchase restoration, subscription management, and more reliable trial and pricing details.
refreshed the everyday experience with more coherent screens, responsive interactions, and weekly summaries of missed tasks and restriction time.

summary.text: this week was mostly about making due or die explain itself instead of asking people to decipher the whole thing through vibes alone. the setup, pricing, day-to-day screens, and weekly accountability loop now tell a more consistent story, with just enough motion to keep the app from feeling like a tax form.
